text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 loss. The Hansen/UMD data shows approximately 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss within the asset in 2023. This observation is corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 data, which agrees that there was forest at the event area in 2020. The MGAP forest map of 2021 indicates that the area was predominantly planted forest, specifically Eucalyptus grandis. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim of tree-cover loss in 2023.
